name: Talking about the future
note: will for predictions, decisions made now and offers/promises. be going to for plans and intentions, and predictions from present evidence. Present continuous for fixed arrangements with a time/place. After when/if/before/as soon as, use the present, not will.

questions.q: He said, "I will watch TV". He said ______ .
I'm going to a concert tomorrow evening. So ______ .
I will go home for vacation as soon as I ______ my exams.
They say this but then the difficulty is trying to find out when the measures are coming into effect and when they will be ______
questions.fs: They say this but then the difficulty is trying to find out when the measures are coming into effect and when they will be ratified.

questions.q: They promised that they ______ Mike next year.
Be sure to reread your composition for errors before you ______ it in to the teacher tomorrow.
The government next announces that measures are due to come into ______ that will change the whole process.
questions.fs: The government next announces that measures are due to come into force that will change the whole process.

questions.q: Frank: 'I hear that the Government is going to abolish income tax.' Jill: ' ______ '
questions.fs: Frank: 'I hear that the Government is going to abolish income tax.' Jill: 'That'll be the day!'

questions.q: Very often someone will give a ______ of a film and when you see it for yourself, it's quite different.
questions.fs: Very often someone will give a description of a film and when you see it for yourself, it's quite different.

questions.q: I recommended that the patient ______ on as soon as possible.
Brenda likes going to the theatre and ______ .
I'm going to the hairdresser's to ______ .
I'm going to the passport office ______ .
